items.summary: Approve one bounded engineer task for xxxtea.com. The change is isolated, reversible, and supported by supplied Search Console evidence. Verify all five competing URLs and select the primary page from existing intent before editing. Permit only SEO metadata, canonical, and relevant internal-link changes; no content deletion, navigation changes, credentials, infrastructure, or telemetry changes. Require focused tests, build success, exact changed-field documentation, and measurement after 14 days or 100 new impressions using available clicks, impressions, indexed status, and sessions. Do not infer revenue, margin, CAC, payback, or cost-to-learn.
